input: Find one-week specialty camps (science, history, nature, arts) run by nonprofits for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Madison county Marshall Mars Hill nonprofit summer camp 2026 arts nature
Johnson City nonprofit nature science camps week
Appalachian Institute Creative Learning 2026 summer official

candidates.name: Madison County Arts Council
candidates.note: Weeklong Junior Appalachian Musicians beginner and returning-student camps ran in July 2025.

candidates.name: Madison County Community Learning Centers
candidates.note: K–8 themed summer camps at Woodson Branch Nature School; 2026 registration announced.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: One-week 2025 art camps covered painting, wheel throwing, nature-inspired clay, printmaking and photography.

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: Art-based day camps and teen workshops; 2025 offerings included one- and two-week camps.

candidates.name: McDowell Arts Council Association
candidates.note: Children’s Summer Clay Camp ran Monday–Friday, June 15–19, 2026.

candidates.name: KidSenses Children's Interactive Museum
candidates.note: 2025 specialty camps included fossils, animals, colorful creations and messy science; full- and half-day options.

candidates.name: Dreaming Stone Arts and Ecology Center
candidates.note: Ages 8–14; two Monday–Friday arts, ecology and circus camps in 2026, with Saturday performances.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong Renaissance specialty camps for grades 1–12, plus bluegrass and teen pharmacy programs.
